name: Biological and Agricultural Engineering PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 general admission dates not confirmed. Admission model and program-specific documents/GRE policy not established.

publishedDeadlines.label: International fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual international deadline; earlier program dates may apply.

applicationFee.note: International75USD; domestic65. Central McNair waiver and limited competitive departmental codes; no program-specific code offer confirmed. International applicants must confirm category eligibility before payment.

english.note: PTE 58 accepted; Duolingo not accepted. Listed exempt countries or accredited US degree may waive testing. TA speaking requirements are separate.

documents: Uploaded transcripts and degree certificates; certified English translations for international records
requirements.note: Engineering BS equivalent normally required; non-engineers may enter provisionally with undergraduate engineering coursework. Additional application checklist must be confirmed with department.

funding.note: 2023 linked handbook: research assistantships appointed for nine months; summer not automatic, renewal depends on review. Beyond 36 months for doctoral students only special circumstances; no universal funding guarantee.
